model: Current 571-feature LightGBM, fixed threshold 0.57, historical expanding-window predictions
spike_definitions: Actual half-hour NSW price strictly above 300 or 1000 AUD/MWh
after_spike_day: Previous market day contained a spike; may also be a spike day itself
note: Retrospective diagnostics, not forecast-time spike labels; no holdout market days included. Spikes differ from the price-up target.
